capabilities: Open configured websites in workspace tabs
Switch to a note when the cursor leaves the page
Restore the page by hovering its tab header
Pause and mute page media while hidden
Provide a toolbar with site switcher and navigation
disambiguation: Not a break timer or focus mode; it opens a configured website in a workspace tab and returns to a note when the cursor leaves the page.
extras: Desktop only: relies on Electron's webview and screen APIs and does nothing on mobile. Distributed through BRAT or manual install; settings are stored in the plugin's data.json and no telemetry is collected.
problem: Keeping a website open beside your notes means leaving Obsidian or switching windows, and getting back to a note afterwards takes manual effort.
summary: Web-tab plugin that opens configured sites in workspace tabs and switches back to a note when the cursor leaves the page.
